Yes, please go ahead and build it. Those six flows are the heart of what I came in wanting — effortless saving, my own labels, finding things easily, a read-later queue, setting things aside safely, and truly deleting when I mean to — and all the fiddly corner cases we walked through were handled the way I'd hope. I'm comfortable with this as the scope for the finished app.

One small reminder for the build, since it's something I raised early and it didn't get its own demo: I mentioned wanting to jot my own little private notes on a bookmark — a line or two of my own thoughts — and to have those notes searchable like everything else. I'd like that to make it into the real thing. If it's easier to show me that once it's implemented rather than prototype it separately, that's fine.

Otherwise, you have my go-ahead to start. I'll give it a proper look once it's all working together as the actual app.
